questions.question: How does reliance on AI-driven training recommendations affect athlete autonomy and self-regulation?
questions.reason: Preliminary evidence establishes a link between AI reliance and reduced self-regulation, warranting further investigation into how this preferences emerges in athletes.
questions.configured_seed: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
